items.title: Question 0.1: Understanding Imports
items.instruction: Import statements tell Java where to find the classes and libraries that the program will use. These imports bring in functionality from the Apache Spark framework.
items.reveal: These import statements load classes from the Apache Spark library. The package names like `org.apache.spark.sql` indicate these are from the Spark SQL module (for working with structured data), `org.apache.spark.ml` is for machine learning, and `org.apache.spark.ml.feature` contains tools for processing features (like text). These imports allow the program to use Spark's data processing and machine learning capabilities.
